'''June 2001 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pleasanton, California on 9 June 2001. [[Philip Green]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2438">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-11-pleasanton-ca-6-9-01d2438/ pleasanton-ca-6-9-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 11 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-11-pleasanton-ca-6-9-01d2438/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Philip Green]]
